stopped_items: D2's 'register the pipeline in cron-job-pipelines.ts with a daily cadence': the tree contradicts the premise. cron-job-pipelines.ts has no registration shape; it DERIVES the pg_cron job-to-pipeline map from cron.job and pg_proc, and a GHA step is in neither. The GHA-side registry, PIPELINE_BUDGET_REFS in apps/civitics/src/lib/pipeline-runtime-stats.ts, got the entry. The freshness census (FIX-1011) lists any data_sync_log pipeline by derivation, so it needed no change. A DECLARED daily cadence would be a rollup_watch_overrides row, which is a migration, and this prompt is code-only. So none was declared. Until the census has 4 closures it reads cadence_source default (168 h) and never escalates. Receipts §10's 48 h 'missing' line is the interim watch.
